//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Just Player Heads -> Config

Enable Just Player Heads.//: Whether Just Player Heads is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

playerDropsHeadOnDeath.//: If enabled, allows players to drop their head on death.

playerHeadDropChance.//: Sets the chance of a player dropping their head if 'playerDropsHeadOnDeath' is enabled. min: 0.0001, max: 1
